For each trade agreement signed: this city pays 80 knowledge and 10 wood; the other side pays 40 knowledge and 10 wood. Each trip also costs 12 food for travel, 3 wood, 0.2 tools, and 0.1 parts. Goods are delivered at the destination and stored on return to the city. If no deal is made, the original goods are brought back; travel expenses already spent are not refunded.

Every 10 seconds, public recordkeeping costs for both sides are calculated under the current “central/local” and “written/customary” systems: this city {变量1}; the other side {变量2}. Costs are deducted only while two local recordkeepers are on duty and both sides have sufficient funds. If payment is overdue or national administration is interrupted, dispatch of new carts and fulfillment tracking are paused, but existing membership status is retained.

To admit them to Common Law, first complete three successful caravan trips returned to the city and 600 consecutive seconds of valid records. Then this city must pay 150 knowledge/8 tools, and the other side 100 knowledge/8 tools.
